scope: R4 candidate-ledger disposition and game ancestry; later framework commits inventoried, not claimed individually runtime-qualified

candidates.name: render-ring
candidates.reason: Batched publication, separate cache lines and burst accounting; 8,843 ring checks in both publication modes.

candidates.name: GL state cache
candidates.reason: Cache blend/stencil queries; hidden GL and actual menu transitions qualified.

candidates.name: fixed sampler units
candidates.reason: Initialize program sampler units once; exact GL output matches diagnostic reference.

candidates.name: HD miss path
candidates.reason: Allocation-free broad-phase misses and delayed leases; HD pack and real GL tests pass.

candidates.name: disc read-ahead
candidates.reason: MStan marked experimental: CHD, mapped CD-DA and mount lifetime remain unqualified. Not a demonstrated remedy for the measured racing render cost.

candidates.name: Windows render priority
candidates.reason: Windows-only scheduling policy; Mac cannot measure its benefit or audio/starvation impact. No silent default priority increase.

candidates.name: threaded draw contexts
candidates.reason: Different CPU/GTE/PGXP ownership and codegen architecture; transport tests do not qualify complete game frames.

candidates.name: packet/presentation workers
candidates.reason: Original fork pipeline has unresolved visual/identity evidence; not a standalone optimization to merge.

candidates.name: rewind worker
candidates.reason: Depends on old native-raster/boot-state/rewind contracts; current HD-resident upstream rewind retained.

candidates.name: triangle/setup grouping
candidates.reason: MStan ledger records historical 5.73 vs 5.74 ms with roughly 10% variation; no demonstrated useful gain.

candidates.name: display-layout cache
candidates.reason: Same low-priority/inconclusive assessment in the source candidate ledger.

candidates.name: inactive netplay native routing
candidates.reason: Targets function_entry_has_hook, absent from the pinned native-entry interface; do not port one hunk without its newer routing/codegen contract.

candidates.name: resident guard bulk hashing
candidates.reason: Current tree has the guest_ranges_match definition but no R4/runtime call sites. Follow-ups 51639afc and 40e460a4 must accompany any future adoption.

candidates.name: offline launcher disc hashing
candidates.reason: Startup/plan preparation change, not a racing-frame optimization; belongs with its mod-plan lifecycle tests during upstream refresh.

candidates.name: thread-CPU watchdog budget
candidates.reason: Changes watchdog semantics, not rendering throughput; do not hide the observed hidden-window VSync wait by relaxing the watchdog.

candidates.name: immutable geometry presentation
candidates.reason: New lineage/geometry sampling/raster/presentation stack with multiple prerequisite commits; not a drop-in recovery of the six candidates.
